response.overview: Developed over a year and completed in spring 2025, the work examines anger as an emotion often suppressed or misunderstood, yet capable of generating profound personal and social change. Through performative gestures, shifting light, and immersive sound, Reverie reveals the fragile boundary between control and eruption, vulnerability and strength. The piece invites viewers into a contemplative state where anger becomes not an act of destruction, but a force of renewal — a space where pain turns into power.
response.title: Reverie
